scope: Microscopic polyangiitis as one of the ANCA-associated vasculitides.

keyRecommendations.text: AAV is subdivided into granulomatosis with polyangiitis, microscopic polyangiitis, and eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis.
The disease is pauci-immune neutrophilic small-vessel inflammation associated with PR3 or MPO antibodies.

Granulomatous respiratory inflammation characterises granulomatosis with polyangiitis. Kidney disease is frequent in both that disease and microscopic polyangiitis. MPO-ANCA microscopic polyangiitis has the worst kidney prognosis in this review.
keyRecommendations.population: Microscopic polyangiitis and granulomatosis with polyangiitis

clinicalBottomLine: Microscopic polyangiitis is the non-eosinophilic ANCA vasculitis that is not defined by respiratory granulomas. It is a pauci-immune small-vessel disease, often MPO-ANCA, with frequent kidney involvement and a poor renal outlook, and alveolar haemorrhage can occur across ANCA vasculitis.
notableCaveats: The source is an AAV review, not an MPA-only monograph. Questions use its statements about MPA, GPA, and shared AAV features. It is licensed CC BY-NC.
